Hero.title: Gamified Solutions
Hero.subtitle: Branded games that draw a crowd, hold attention and make people remember you.

Gamification.title: What is gamification?
Gamification.intro: It means using the logic of games (challenge, score, reward and ranking) to capture attention, teach and engage. From a gender reveal party to a company convention, the game becomes the center of the experience.

About.title: Who is behind it
About.intro: I'm Lucas Zaranza (Zazá), a fullstack developer with over 10 years of experience. I started making games with Unity3D and C#, and today I also build web interfaces with React, Next.js and TypeScript. Combining both is what Zaza Games is about.
